params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip for pagination.

items.docs: Returns a list of all fine-tuning jobs associated with the authenticated user's account, including their status, base model, hyperparameters, and training progress.

Creates and starts a new fine-tuning job that customizes a base model using the specified training dataset and hyperparameters. The job runs on GPU infrastructure and produces a fine-tuned model artifact upon completion. Supported task types include Question Answering (QA) and non-QA text generation.

params.name: job_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the fine-tuning job.

items.docs: Returns details about a specific fine-tuning job including its current status, base model, hyperparameters, training metrics, and the resulting fine-tuned model identifier upon completion.

params.name: job_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the fine-tuning job.

items.docs: Cancels a running fine-tuning job. The job will be stopped and any partial training progress will be discarded. Credits for unused compute time may be refunded.
Returns a list of training datasets uploaded by the authenticated user. Datasets are in CSV format and can be used for fine-tuning jobs.

Uploads a new CSV training dataset for use in fine-tuning jobs. The dataset must be in CSV format; other file extensions are not supported and will return an error. The CSV should contain columns appropriate for the intended task type.

params.name: dataset_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the training dataset.

items.docs: Returns details about a specific training dataset including its name, size, row count, and upload timestamp.

params.name: dataset_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the training dataset.

items.docs: Deletes a training dataset. Datasets that are currently in use by a running fine-tuning job cannot be deleted.
Returns a list of fine-tuned models produced by completed fine-tuning jobs. These models can be used for inference on the Qubrid AI platform.

params.name: model_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the fine-tuned model.

items.docs: Deletes a fine-tuned model artifact. The model will no longer be available for inference.
